an11.9:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Ñātike viharati Giñjakāvasathe.
an11.9:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Sandho yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Sandhaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:-- 2.
an11.9:2.4: Assakhaḷuṅko hi Sandha doṇiyā baddho ‘yavasaṃ yavasan' ti jhāyati.
an11.9:2.6: Na hi Sandha assakaḷuṅkassa doṇiyā baddhassa evaṃ hoti
an11.9:2.7: ‘kin nu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati, kim assāhaṃ paṭikaromī' ti?
an11.9:2.8: So doṇiyā baddho ‘yavasaṃ yavasan' ti jhāyati.
an11.9:2.9: Evam eva kho Sandha idh' ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko araññagato pi rukkhamūlagato pi suññāgāragato pi kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na ppajānāti.
an11.9:2.10: So kāmarāgaṃ yeva antaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati.
an11.9:2.14: vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati vicikicchāparetena, uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na ppajānāti.
an11.9:2.15: So vicikicchaṃ yeva antaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati.
an11.9:2.16: So paṭhavim pi nissāya jhāyati, āpam pi nissāya jhāyati, tejam pi nissāya jhāyati, vāyam pi nissāya jhāyati, ākāsānañcāyatanam pi nissāya jhāyati, viññāṇañcāyatanam pi nissāya jhāyati, ākiñcaññāyatanam pi nissāya jhāyati, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanam pi nissāya jhāyati, idhalokam pi nissāya jhāyati, paralokam pi nissāya jhāyati, yam p' idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tam pi nissāya jhāyati.
an11.9:3.2: Bhadro hi Sandha assājānīyo doṇiyā baddho na ‘yavasaṃ yavasan' ti jhāyati.
an11.9:3.4: Bhadrassa hi Sandha assājānīyassa doṇiyā baddhassa evaṃ hoti
an11.9:3.5: ‘kin nu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati, kim assāhaṃ paṭikaromī' ti?
an11.9:3.6: So doṇiyā baddho na ‘yavasaṃ yavasan' ti jhāyati.
an11.9:3.7: Bhadro hi Sandha assājānīyo yathā iṇaṃ yathā baddhaṃ yathā jāniṃ yathā kaliṃ evaṃ patodassa ajjhoharaṇaṃ samanupassati.
an11.9:3.8: Evam eva kho Sandha bhadro purisājānīyo araññagato pi rukkhamūlagato pi suññāgāragato pi na kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an11.9:3.12: na vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na vicikicchāparetena, uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an11.9:3.13: So neva paṭhaviṃ nissāya jhāyati, na āpaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na tejaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na vāyaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na idhalokaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na paralokaṃ nissāya jhāyati, yaṃ p' idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tam pi nissāya na jhāyati,
an11.9:3.15: Evaṃ jhāyiñ ca pana Sandha bhadraṃ purisājānīyaṃ sa-indā devā sabrahmakā sapajāpatikā ārakā 'va namassanti:
an11.9:5.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Sandho Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an11.9:5.2: ‘kathaṃ jhāyī pana bhante bhadro purisājānīyo jhāyati? So neva paṭhaviṃ nissāya jhāyati, na āpaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na vāyaṃ nissāya jhāyati,na ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na idhalokaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na paralokaṃ nissāya jhāyati, yam p' idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tam pi nissāya na jhāyati,
an11.9:5.4: Kathaṃ jhāyiñ ca pana bhante bhadraṃ purisājānīyaṃ sa-indā devā sabrahmakā sapajāpatikā ārakā 'va namassanti:
an11.9:7.1: Idha Sandha bhadrassa purisājānīyassa paṭhaviyā paṭhavīsaññā vibhūtā hoti, āpasmiṃ āposaññā vibhūtā hoti, tejasmiṃ tejosaññā vibhūtā hoti, vāyasmiṃ vāyosaññā vibhūtā hoti, ākāsānañcāyatane ākāsānañcāyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti, viññāṇañcāyatane viññāṇañcāyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti, ākiñcaññāyatane ākiñcaññāyatanasaññā vibūtā hoti, nevasaññānāsaññāyatane nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti, idhaloke idhalokasaññā vibhūtā hoti, paraloke paralokasaññā vibhūtā hoti, yam p' idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tatrāpi saññā vibhūtā hoti.
an11.9:7.2: Evaṃ jhāyī kho Sandha bhadro purisājānīyo neva paṭhaviṃ nissāya jhāyati, na āpaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na tejaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na vāyaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na idhalokaṃ nissāya jhāyati, na paralokaṃ nissāya jhāyati,
an11.9:7.3: yam p' idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tam pi nissāya na jhāyati,
an11.9:7.5: Evaṃ jhāyiñ ca pana Sandha bhadraṃ purisājānīyaṃ sa-indā devā sabrahmakā sapajāpatikā ārakā 'va namassanti:
